One lamp is a purchase. Two lamps are a decision. Symmetry is the cheapest luxury there is: one centre line, mirrored sides, and the room reads deliberate.

Start with the sofa. A pair of lamps, a pair of cushions, and stop there.

Save this for the next lamp aisle.
